trends.product_direction: First-Year Home Maintenance Playbook: Everything your first home needs. Nothing it doesn't.
trends.raw_quote: I now am feeling overwhelmed by everything I don't/didn't know. I have found a few home maintenance lists, but even then I don't know where to start.
trends.problem_statement: First-time homeowners inherit a property and face a running list of tasks with zero context for what matters, what can wait, and what will cost thousands if ignored. Generic checklists exist but assume baseline knowledge they don't have.
pain_points: Information overload without priority — 200+ tasks with no sense of urgency
No cost context — $20 DIY fix vs $5,000 emergency invisible until it hits
No DIY vs. professional decision framework — decision paralysis on every repair
No tracking system — do it once and forget when it needs doing again
trends.product_idea: A 10-page prioritized guide with seasonal breakdown, cost-context decision tree, and tracking system. Not a generic checklist — a system that tells first-year homeowners what matters most.
trends.reason: High conviction (9.0/10). Existing draft and PDFs in final_products. Proven product with completed skeleton, draft, distribution, and PDFs.
